provenance.reuse: Original articulated hierarchy and pose mathematics reused as guide infrastructure only. Baphomet goat anatomy, ridged horns, cloven hooves, loop staff, bronze ritual waist covering and final raster body were independently authored. No other completed body raster or recolor-only coverage. Seven NW ready boundaries explicitly reuse this same actor’s corrected idle0 through raw RGBA copying; all substantive action phases remain authored.
provenance.gait: All eight native gaits use separately authored support halves. Five held contact pairs SW/W/NE/E/SE were finally replaced at frames4/5 from original grounded two-bone IK guide geometry; first halves and passing6/recovery7 retained. Earlier colored diagnostic intermediates were rejected and never packed.
